changes: First release: 76 factory programs of the Alesis Quadraverb (1989) on FX2: reverbs, delays, choruses, flanges, pitch shifts and Leslies.
PROG (A) picks the program by its number on the original Quadraverb; MIX (F) sets dry and wet, 0 exact dry.
Needs the Modwerk base with program areas and the stream channel, over USB.
Known issue: not compared with a real Quadraverb; reverb times are about 5 % shorter than the original's.
Known issue: the gated programs and VERB SHIFTER are not in this release yet; the Leslies play their default speed.
